about: Answer key for the service FMEA (task FMEA), written before any run, from the code (app/) and context/system-context.md. source: where the knowledge lives (in_code: stated in the code or its comments; inferable: a diligent reader of the code could work it out; context_only: written only in the system context). about: role (the service's place in the bank: upstream and downstream effects, business processes) or internals (one code path's own behaviour). S/O/D are a guide for the judge, not a target. dependants: the teams and systems an effect should name. facts: distinctive values from the system context, searched for in outputs (traceability).

entries.mode: A payment is booked twice in the core ledger
entries.cause: a retry or manual repost after a ledger timeout uses a new posting reference; the ledger may already have booked the timed-out posting, and the reference is its idempotency key
entries.effect: customer debited twice; ledger and scheme don't reconcile, so finance's morning reconciliation breaks
entries.detection: finance reconciliation break the next morning; customer complaint

entries.mode: The scheme accepts a payment but the service loses its record of it
entries.cause: a scheme timeout is not handled: the request fails and the transaction rolls back, although the scheme may have accepted the instruction
entries.effect: money leaves the customer with no payment record, no ledger posting and no balance change; the customer may pay again (paid twice); reconciliation shows a payment sent but not posted
entries.detection: reconciliation break; customer complaint; 5xx errors on the payments endpoint

entries.mode: Payments are sent without fraud screening
entries.cause: the fraud screening client exists but payments don't call it (policy FRD-7 requires every payment out to be screened)
entries.effect: fraud losses for customers and the bank; breach of the bank's screening policy; the fraud team never sees risky payments
entries.detection: fraud losses reported by customers; audit against FRD-7; no screening calls in metrics
entries.note: Re-tagged from context_only to inferable after the pilot (amendment 8): the unused FraudScreeningClient shows the gap in the code; only the policy (FRD-7) is context.

entries.mode: A payment goes through unscreened when the fraud service is slow or down
entries.cause: screening fails open on a timeout or error instead of holding the payment (the bank's rule: fail closed after 2 seconds)
entries.effect: fraud losses; breach of the screening policy
entries.detection: not detected without a metric on screening timeouts

entries.mode: A fraud REFER is treated as a rejection
entries.cause: every answer other than ACCEPT is mapped to failure, instead of holding the payment for review
entries.effect: genuine payments refused; customers' bills unpaid; the fraud team's review queue is never used; complaints rise
entries.detection: rise in rejected payments; fraud team sees an empty queue

entries.mode: Payments queued for a bank holiday are rejected by the scheme
entries.cause: working days are computed from weekends only; bank holidays are not known
entries.effect: customer's payment fails on the day; bill unpaid, late fees; complaints
entries.detection: scheme rejections with an invalid-date code (DT01) after a bank holiday

entries.mode: Queued payments are not sent on their execution date
entries.cause: the 06:00 queued-payment job fails, doesn't run, or stops partway
entries.effect: customers' payments go late; late fees; complaints
entries.detection: queued payments past their execution date (operations' exceptions report); job monitoring

entries.mode: A customer notification contains a full account number or sort code
entries.cause: a template or parameter change sends the raw account number instead of the last four digits
entries.effect: data-protection breach the bank must report; customer data exposed on lock screens
entries.detection: customer report; data-loss-prevention scan of outgoing messages

entries.mode: Customers are not told about their payments
entries.cause: the notification service is down or rejects the message; failures are only logged (best effort, no retry)
entries.effect: customer unsure whether the payment went; may pay again; calls to support
entries.detection: warnings in the logs; notification-service error rate

entries.mode: An account is closed with money still in it
entries.cause: the closure check uses the balance copy held in this service rather than the ledger
entries.effect: customer funds stranded; manual remediation by operations; complaint
entries.detection: ledger shows a balance on a closed account; operations exceptions

entries.mode: Payments are approved or refused against an out-of-date balance
entries.cause: the balance here is a copy, overwritten from the ledger at 02:00 and only debited locally during the day; incoming money and other debits aren't reflected
entries.effect: customer refused a payment they can afford, or allowed one that overdraws the ledger account; balances shown in the app are wrong
entries.detection: difference between the copy and the ledger balance; customer complaints

entries.mode: Statements are wrong or missing
entries.cause: statement data is incomplete or wrong (e.g. built from wrong balances or missing transactions)
entries.effect: customers see wrong statements; the monthly regulatory return, built from the statements, is wrong
entries.detection: return validation; customer complaint

entries.mode: Payments sent to the scheme are never posted to the ledger
entries.cause: a ledger timeout leaves the payment POSTING_FAILED and it is not reposted (manual follow-up only)
entries.effect: the customer's ledger balance is too high; ledger and scheme don't reconcile; operations workload
entries.detection: POSTING_FAILED payments on operations' exceptions report; reconciliation break

entries.mode: A customer's payment is created twice
entries.cause: a double tap or a client retry of POST /payments: the endpoint has no idempotency key, and each payment gets a new scheme reference
entries.effect: payee paid twice; customer out of pocket
entries.detection: two identical payments seconds apart; customer complaint

entries.mode: The daily limit is exceeded
entries.cause: concurrent payments both pass the limit check (no locking), or the day boundary is computed wrongly
entries.effect: more paid out than the bank's limit allows; larger fraud exposure
entries.detection: sum of a day's payments above the limit

entries.mode: An account is overdrawn by payments
entries.cause: concurrent payments both pass the balance check (no locking on the account)
entries.effect: overdrawn account; charges; customer harm
entries.detection: negative balances

entries.mode: Payments around the cut-off are sent or queued wrongly
entries.cause: time-zone errors (UTC against UK time, clock changes) or a server clock off; a same-day instruction reaches the scheme after 15:30
entries.effect: scheme rejects the payment (DT01) or it is delayed a day; customer late fees
entries.detection: scheme rejections near the cut-off

entries.mode: The customer isn't told that the scheme rejected their payment
entries.cause: on a scheme rejection the dispatcher records REJECTED and returns without notifying the customer
entries.effect: customer believes the bill is paid; late fees; complaints
entries.detection: complaints; rejected payments without a notification

entries.mode: One bank's data is visible to another (tenant isolation fails)
entries.cause: a query or access check that doesn't filter by tenant
entries.effect: data breach across banks on the platform; regulator
entries.detection: access tests; audit logs

entries.mode: Someone other than the account holder makes a payment
entries.cause: an access check or scope check is missing or wrong on a payment endpoint
entries.effect: unauthorised payments; fraud; regulatory breach
entries.detection: access tests; audit of payment creators

entries.mode: Data is lost when the service restarts
entries.cause: the database is in-memory H2 with create-drop schema, re-seeded from fixtures
entries.effect: payments, notes and cases lost; complaints and regulatory records incomplete
entries.detection: data missing after a deploy

entries.mode: Nobody can use the app or back office: every call is refused
entries.cause: the identity service's signing key changes or tokens can't be validated
entries.effect: customers can't see accounts or pay through the app or online banking; back-office staff locked out
entries.detection: spike in 401 responses; channel alerts
